IC1: Healthy, women ages 18 to 39yo with BMI <30
IC2: Regular menstrual cycles  [AND]with duration between 24-35 days
IC3: Completion of screening visit where ovulation will be assessed with blood draw for progesterone level (must be 5ng/mL or greater)
IC4: Not seeking pregnancy during the study period
IC5: Use of a non-hormonal form of contraception, such as: sterilization (tu [OR]bal ligation, Es [OR]sure), copper IUD (in [OR]trauterine device), barrier methods or  [OR]abstinence
